moves.name: beatmatch by ear
moves.what: matching two tempos by listening and nudging, with no sync

moves.name: sync
moves.what: the deck holds the tempo for you so your hands are free

moves.name: long blend
moves.what: both records audible together for thirty seconds or more

moves.name: bass swap
moves.what: drop the outgoing low as you raise the incoming, so only one bass plays

moves.name: phrase mix
moves.what: start the incoming record on a phrase boundary, not just a beat

moves.name: harmonic mix
moves.what: choosing the next record by key so the two do not fight

moves.name: acapella over instrumental
moves.what: a vocal from one record over the music of another

moves.name: double drop
moves.what: both records arriving at their drop on the same beat

moves.name: cut
moves.what: one record stops, the next starts, on the beat

moves.name: echo out
moves.what: throw a delay on the outgoing record and pull the fader under it

moves.name: filter fade
moves.what: sweep the outgoing record's low end away rather than its volume

moves.name: brake
moves.what: the record slows to a stop as if the power went

moves.name: backspin
moves.what: the record is thrown backwards and the next one lands

moves.name: EQ ride
moves.what: moving the three bands through a mix rather than setting them once

moves.name: filter sweep
moves.what: opening or closing the whole record's tone over several bars

moves.name: stem swap
moves.what: the drums of one record under the vocal of another, live

moves.name: tone play
moves.what: pitching a cue or a stab to make a melody out of one sound

moves.name: baby scratch
moves.what: the record pushed and pulled with the fader open

moves.name: chirp
moves.what: the fader closes at each turn, so the sound is clipped at both ends

moves.name: transformer
moves.what: the record runs and the fader chops it into pieces

moves.name: beat juggle
moves.what: two copies of one record cut against each other into a new pattern

moves.name: loop roll
moves.what: a short loop held over the record, which carries on underneath

moves.name: censor
moves.what: the record plays backwards, silently, and returns in time

moves.name: loop the intro
moves.what: hold a short intro open until there is time to mix into it

moves.name: hot cue juggle
moves.what: jumping between marked points to rearrange the record as it plays

moves.name: slip trick
moves.what: loop, scratch or reverse while the record keeps running underneath

moves.name: phrase jump
moves.what: moving a whole breath forward or back, landing in time
